segments.name: Specialty finance
segments.description: Lends to and invests in U.S. middle-market companies through first and second lien senior secured loans, subordinated debt, and preferred equity.
segments.evidence: The Company operates through a single operating and reporting segment with an investment objective to generate both current income and capital appreciation through debt and equity investments.
